#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 2 ]; then
  echo "usage: bash percentage.sh BASE NEW" >&2
  exit 2
fi

base="$1"
new="$2"

if [ "$base" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "error: base must not be zero" >&2
  exit 2
fi

echo $(( (new - base) * 100 / base ))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# normalize.sh: 去除参数首尾空白后转大写输出
# 纯空白或空参数输出空行并正常退出
arg="${1-}"
trimmed=$(printf '%s' "$arg" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
printf '%s\n' "${trimmed^^}"
